releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.8 contains service 0.2.5.7. HWM Terminal now uses adaptive burst polling: idle workstations remain at a five second terminal poll, but after a technician command is received that workstation switches to one second polling for five minutes and extends the burst after every command. This makes a live troubleshooting session feel close to immediate without forcing every managed workstation to poll Azure every second all day. Immediate service startup polling, terminal security, one-shot execution, output limits, command expiry, auditing, Mesh recovery, tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged.
